newsitem.title: USA: CBOT corn closes higher on wheat rally, spreading.
newsitem.headline: CBOT corn closes higher on wheat rally, spreading.

text.p: CBOT corn futures closed higher on a strong rally in wheat futures with bull spreading also leading the advances, traders said.

"Everyone wanted to be easier this morning after yesterday's close but wheat took over plus the oats bullish consensus was down to 22 which was very oversold," said Mark Cermak of O'Connor and Co. "Oats and wheat caught everyone in the corn and bean pits on the short side.
Iowa Grain bull spread three million bushels of December/March, Tenco Inc did three million Dec/Mar and two million Dec/July and Cargill Inc did 3.5 million Mar/May, traders said.
A key local did one million bushels spread between the December/March, December/May and December/July, traders said.
"Professional spreaders are putting on bull spreads and taking off bear spreads," a floor source said.

Slow farmer selling contributed to the gains but there was little fresh news to stir the market with USDA's recently-released November crop production and supply/demand reports continuing to cap rallies.
Corn closed 1-3/4 to 4-3/4 cents per bushel higher, with December up 4-3/4 at $2.70 a bushel.
